name: Ferrafor
description: The last known yew on Lorwyn-Shadowmoor, cruel in Shadowmoor.

description_citations.text: "List of secondary characters/Lorwyn-Shadowmoor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A secret cutting of Colfenor's sapling is saved by Rhys and awakened by a special Rising as Ferrafor, the last yew treefolk.
timeline.quote: Awoken by a special version of the Rising, her first moments were of death and pain.

citation.text: "The Legends of Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: The sapling plays a role in the Great Aurora and the war between Oona and Maralen but does not survive; a cutting is saved and revived as Ferrafor.
timeline.quote: The sapling would not survive the ensuing conflict

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Rhys, Colfenor's former apprentice, saved the cutting from which Ferrafor grew.
relations.quote: saved by Colfenor's former apprentice, Rhys

citation.text: "The Legends of Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2026.

pages_say.description: The last yew treefolk, awakened by a special Rising; cruel and vindictive in Shadowmoor.

citation.text: "The Legends of Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2026.

pages_say.description: A remnant of Colfenor's lineage revived from a cutting of the sapling, found in the Great Forest.
